svg.text: N8N BUILD · SAMPLE CLIENT · PROCESS MAP

g.text: Missing details get a clear error
back, and invalid forms are still
reply in under a second, before
Fixed rules score the lead out of
customers get a rep; low priority
Picks the rep for that lead type
A short reply in the lead’s own
Sent with the rep as reply-to, or
a safe standard reply if the AI
Tags the rep with the score,
Checks for leads that nobody has
Finds leads with no rep, or not
Hands them to the sales manager,
One website enquiry in, a scored lead with a rep on it in 15 minutes out — or the manager knows.
